ready.heading: Ready message
ready.pending: Goes to the customer when this ticket is ready.
ready.noContact: Not sent: no email or phone on file
ready.notConfigured: Not sent: messages aren’t set up

bill.heading: Bill
bill.ownerOnly: An owner or manager sends the bill.
bill.needsEmail: Add an email to the customer’s record to send the bill.

notice.readyNoContact: No email or phone on file, so no message went.
notice.readyNotConfigured: Messages aren’t set up for this shop, so nothing went.
notice.readyFailed: The ready message didn’t go through.
notice.readyNotReady: The ticket isn’t ready, so nothing was sent.
notice.billAlready: This ticket already has a bill.
notice.billNotConnected: Connect Stripe in Settings to send bills.
notice.billNotAuthorized: Only an owner or manager can send a bill.
notice.billInvalid: These lines can’t go on a bill. Check each amount and quantity.
notice.billTaxLocation: Tax is on, so this bill needs the customer’s billing address. Send it from Orders.
notice.billStripeFailed: Stripe couldn’t create that bill. Try again in a moment.
notice.remindersOff: Service reminders off for that piece.
notice.remindersOn: Service reminders on for that piece.
